name: research-wiki
description: The Project Owner's adjudication surface for LLM-Wiki: read formal revisions and candidates, author a document change, preview, open the merge request, decide the review, then formalize or reconcile.
notes: The Wiki side spells the decision decide_wiki_review rather than record_review. Same act, same formalize capability; do not look for record_review here.

The Wiki merge request differs from the Mapping one in a way that bites: create_wiki_merge_request takes merge_request_id from the caller, while the Mapping create_merge_request derives buffer_id from preview_id. There is nothing to read back — pick a stable id, e.g. wiki-mr-<proposal_id>, and reuse it on retry. A fresh id on retry is a second merge request.

decide_wiki_review requires selected_solution_id. A Wiki candidate may carry more than one solution; the decision names which one is being approved, and leaving it out is a schema rejection rather than a default.

decide_wiki_review is only approved/rejected — there is no returned. Sending a Wiki candidate back for a new version means rejecting it with a reason, and that reason is what the author has to work from.
list_reviewable_wiki_candidates is the Centre Agent's snapshot read and is absent for the same reason as on the Mapping side.
submit_wiki_candidate authoring is not a shortcut around review: decide_wiki_review still runs and formalize_wiki still re-checks the approval actor.

tools.name: get_formal_wiki
tools.description: Read the current formal Wiki revision for a domain. Requires the read or centre capability.

tools.name: list_wiki_candidates
tools.description: Read candidate submissions for a Wiki domain. Requires the read or centre capability.

tools.name: submit_wiki_candidate
tools.description: Submit a Wiki document change with its full reference set against the exact formal base. Requires candidate_submit or centre capability.

tools.name: preview_wiki_review
tools.description: Build the review preview for a Wiki proposal. Requires candidate_review or centre capability.

tools.name: create_wiki_merge_request
tools.description: Lock a ready Wiki preview into a merge-request buffer for owner review. Requires candidate_review or centre capability.

tools.name: decide_wiki_review
tools.description: Record the Project Owner decision for a Wiki merge request. Requires formalize or centre capability.

tools.name: formalize_wiki
tools.description: Promote an Owner-approved Wiki candidate through atomic SQLite activation. Requires formalize or centre capability.

tools.name: reconcile_wiki_formalization
tools.description: Resume the same Wiki formalization operation identity. Requires formalize or centre capability.
